div.div:
v4, draft 2026-11-11
Sources: "VD onDetector Rack View of Cabling" (TMS, stamped 16SEPT2026); "VD Cryostat 27U Detector Racks" naming drawing (20 N + 20 S racks); "DTS to TDE White Rabbit Synchronisation Interface" (EDMS 3482906, draft v7.0); "DAQ Readout Network" PRR specification (EDMS 3463072, v1.0).
Notes and open items (more in the per-subsystem diagrams)
1. All readout switches and servers are in the DAQ barracks; the detector-top rack holds only the patch panel, the 1G Ctrl aggregating switch and the timing splitter, plus the PDS warm electronics.
2. The readout network specification counts 42 VD DAPHNE (5 uplinks); 40 are drawn, one per rack.
3. The patching between the trunk patch panel and the readout switches (top-of-rack patch panels, MTP-12 into 4-way breakout transceivers) is not drawn in detail.
4. The CRP level meter and DPS PDU Ctrl ports are taken from the TMS sheet. The sheet lists 44 on-detector switches for 40 racks.
5. Two 10G Ctrl uplinks per 27U rack are assumed. The mezzanine Ctrl switch for the WR hardware is shown in the TDE diagram only.
6. DTS fanout rack on the cryostat roof (feeds the 27U rack splitters and the DTS-WR interface on the mezzanine): location, hardware and fiber count from the DTS master are not defined here.
